purpose: Live rerun of UAV landing on a forward-moving USV with corrected water rendering and dynamic thrust response
source_exposure_policy: Unique increasing camera timestamps; hold previous exposure when needed for constant 30 fps encoding; retain frame-to-exposure index
vessel_model: Planar surge, sway and yaw; rigid-body mass, added inertia, Coriolis terms, linear and quadratic damping; RK4 integration
vessel_control: Positive body-forward thrust with speed feedback and drag feedforward; target 0.5 m/s
vertical_support: Fixed near-level hull vertical anchor; moving deck contact and stopped-motor dwell checked by original success gate
water_presentation: Separate small-ripple opaque lake surface; simulation-time displacement and normals; speed-driven visual foam; planar reflection disabled for this presentation
limitations: This run does not validate six-DOF wave-induced vessel motion, physical propeller flow, wave-buoyancy coupling or photorealistic fluid simulation
protected_inputs: Original source, map, water master material, binaries, videos and archived data are retained; isolation hashes recorded
bow_alignment: Body yaw-90; geometry-free hull root; fixed hull_visual child yaw180 survives root pose updates. Hull reference posture is preserved, positive surge drives world -Y away from shore, marker/support at +3m retain platform placement. Direction checked in continuous fixed-camera RGB.
evidence_storage: All controller-consumed original encoded payloads and exposure metadata retained in lossless NPZ; all detection JSON retained; PNG previews saved once per simulation second and at phase transitions. Missing PNG previews can be reconstructed from NPZ without approximation.
